> Carbon Technology for Agriculture ("농업에 탄소를 입히다")

## Company Overview
HIGHZONE BIO is an agricultural biotechnology company combining Carbon Material Engineering and Precision Ion Delivery Technology. Our carbon-carrier platform prevents soil mineral lock-up, achieving over 85% plant nutrient bioavailability while sequestering organic carbon in agricultural soils.

## 6 Core Formulations (Product Lineup)
1. **PRO GROW (Phase 01)**: Ionized nitrogen + carbon-carrier complex for rapid vegetative and leaf canopy establishment.
2. **AMAZON MINERAL (Phase 02)**: Ionized trace mineral blend with humic carbon carriers correcting subclinical micronutrient deficiencies.
3. **PRO ROOT (Phase 03)**: Phosphorus-ion + auxin-compatible carbon matrix promoting lateral root branching and rhizosphere vitality.
4. **PRO SHIELD (Phase 04)**: Ionic silicon & potassium defense complex reinforcing cell walls against heat, drought, lodging, and fungal stress.
5. **PRO COLOR (Phase 05)**: Ionized calcium & anthocyanin-support complex maximizing Brix sweetness, natural coloration, and post-harvest shelf life.
6. **The 5th Element / 제5원소 (Phase 06)**: Proprietary 5-element ionic balance complex restoring saline and continuous-cropping soils.
